archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) with SaaS (Swiss) structural elements

cards.base: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-card transition-shadow hover:shadow-card_hover

buttons.primary: bg-stone-900 text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all hover:bg-stone-800 active:scale-95
buttons.coach: bg-[#c7263e] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all hover:bg-[#a61c31] active:scale-95
buttons.studio: bg-[#1a365d] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all hover:bg-[#11243f] active:scale-95
buttons.pilot: bg-[#4ba3b7] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all hover:bg-[#3d8697] active:scale-95
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all

inputs.text: w-full border border-stone-200 bg-stone-50 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-stone-400 focus:border-transparent transition-all outline-none
inputs.chat: w-full border border-stone-200 bg-white rounded-full px-6 py-4 pr-14 shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-stone-400 focus:border-transparent transition-all outline-none

chat_bubbles.user: bg-stone-100 text-stone-900 rounded-3xl rounded-br-none px-5 py-3 max-w-[85%] self-end
chat_bubbles.ai_coach: bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-900 rounded-3xl rounded-bl-none px-5 py-3 max-w-[85%] self-start shadow-sm
chat_bubbles.ai_studio: bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-900 rounded-3xl rounded-bl-none px-5 py-3 max-w-[85%] self-start shadow-sm
chat_bubbles.ai_pilot: bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-900 rounded-3xl rounded-bl-none px-5 py-3 max-w-[85%] self-start shadow-sm

bottom_nav.container: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-stone-200 pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom,20px)] pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center z-50
bottom_nav.item: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 p-2 text-stone-400 transition-colors

animations.card_stagger: animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500 ease-out fill-mode-both

splash_bg.description: Elegant wine glass on a modern table setting

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all icons. Keep stroke-width at 1.5 for a premium, lightweight feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for a mobile-first experience. Enforce a max-width of 'max-w-md mx-auto' for desktop views (and hide scrolling overflow on the body) to simulate the app structure, with a fixed bottom navigation bar.
Ensure the bottom navigation respects safe areas on mobile devices via padding-bottom.
Apply 'Cormorant Garamond' strictly for headers and display text to evoke wine industry sophistication. Use 'Manrope' for standard UI text.
Avoid clutter. Rely heavily on white space (generous padding) and clear visual hierarchy rather than borders.
For the Coach tab, use the red brand color (#c7263e) for primary actions, active nav state, and highlights.
For the Studio tab, use the dark blue brand color (#1a365d - distinct from pilot) for primary actions, active nav state, and highlights.
For the Pilot tab, use the light blue brand color (#4ba3b7) for primary actions, active nav state, and highlights.
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, bottom nav items) using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'data-testid="nav-coach-button"').
Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios against the stone-50 background.
Forms and chats should use clean, rounded-xl/rounded-3xl inputs with subtle shadows instead of heavy thick borders.
